title: Map State
description: Schema for map_state.json — the contract between the GIS agent and the interactive map viewer. The agent writes this file to /tmp/maps/map_state.json and the frontend reads it to render layers.

view.description: Map viewport. Set center and zoom to frame the data. Use gdf.total_bounds to compute the center from data extents.

zoom.description: Zoom level. 1 = world, 8 = state/region, 13 = city, 18 = building.

scale_bar.description: Show a metric/imperial scale bar on the map. Defaults to true.

layers.description: Ordered list of layers. Rendered bottom-to-top (first layer is bottommost).

Layer.description: A single map layer (vector GeoJSON or raster GeoTIFF).

id.description: Unique identifier (snake_case). Used internally for toggling and keying.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the layer control panel.

type.description: 'vector' for GeoJSON layers (default), 'raster' for GeoTIFF layers.

geojson_file.description: Filename of the GeoJSON file (relative to /tmp/maps/). Required for vector layers.

tif_file.description: Filename of the GeoTIFF file (relative to /tmp/maps/). Required for raster layers.

description.description: Short description shown in the Datasets panel.

source.description: Data provenance — file name, data lake artifact, or URL.

feature_count.description: Number of features. Use len(gdf) after filtering.

visible.description: Set to false to add a layer but keep it hidden initially (user can toggle it on).

z_index.description: Stacking order. Higher values render on top. If omitted, layers render in array order.

point_style.description: Point rendering mode. 'circle' renders as scalable CircleMarkers (recommended for data points). 'marker' uses default pin icons.

popup_fields.description: Feature property names to show in popups when the user clicks a feature.

style_by_property.description: Per-feature styling: map a feature property value to a style attribute.

radius_by_property.description: Per-feature radius: read circle radius from a feature property.

color_field.description: Shorthand: feature property name containing a CSS color string for stroke color.

fill_color_field.description: Shorthand: feature property name containing a CSS color string for fill color.

radius_field.description: Shorthand: feature property name containing a numeric radius value.

classify_by.description: Choropleth classification: color features by a numeric or categorical property.

label_field.description: Feature property name whose value is rendered as a text label on the map.

legend.description: Legend to display for this layer. If omitted but classify_by is set, a legend is auto-generated.

value_range.description: Raster [min, max] for normalization. Auto-detected if omitted.

opacity.description: Layer opacity (0–1). Primarily for raster layers.

LayerStyle.description: Leaflet path style applied uniformly to all features in the layer (unless overridden by per-feature styling).

fillColor.description: Fill color for polygons and circle markers.

radius.description: Circle marker radius in pixels (only for point_style='circle').

dashArray.description: Stroke dash pattern. Examples: '5 5' (dashed), '1 5' (dotted), '10 5 1 5' (dash-dot). Use for proposed vs existing infrastructure.

StyleByProperty.description: Map a feature property to a Leaflet style attribute. The feature property must contain a valid CSS color string.

property.description: Feature property name containing the style value (e.g. 'marker_color').

RadiusByProperty.description: Read circle marker radius from a feature property. The property value should be a number.

property.description: Feature property name containing the radius value.

ClassifyBy.description: Choropleth classification. Colors features by a numeric or categorical field. The renderer assigns colors from the 'colors' array based on classification.

field.description: Feature property name to classify by (e.g. 'population', 'soil_type').

method.description: Classification method. 'equal_interval': evenly spaced breaks. 'quantile': equal feature count per class. 'manual': use provided breaks array. 'categorical': one color per unique value.

num_classes.description: Number of classes for equal_interval or quantile methods.

breaks.description: Manual break values (N-1 values for N classes). Required when method='manual'.

categories.description: Category values in display order. Required when method='categorical'.

colors.description: CSS colors, one per class. Length must match num_classes (or categories length for 'categorical').

LabelStyle.description: Text label styling. Labels are rendered as permanent Leaflet tooltips.

haloColor.description: Text halo (outline) color for readability over the map.

minZoom.description: Minimum zoom level at which labels appear. Prevents clutter at low zoom.

Legend.description: Legend shown on the map for this layer.

radius.description: If set, renders a circle swatch at this radius (for point layers).

dashArray.description: If set, renders a line swatch with this dash pattern.
